item.title: Top Iranian cybercriminal on FBI most wanted list reportedly killed in US-Israeli strike
item.summary: A top Iranian hacker wanted by the FBI was allegedly killed in an Israeli strike. Mohammad Mehdi Farhadi Ramin was accused of stealing U.S. identities and sensitive data.

item.title: Dr Phil calls out Mayor Mamdani's wife after she reportedly liked social media posts about Oct 7 'hoax' claims
item.summary: Dr. Phil McGraw criticized NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani's wife, Rama Duwaji, on his podcast Monday, alleging she liked posts that critics say celebrated the Oct. 7 attacks on Israelis.

item.title: US strike on key Iran oil hub would fit Trump's 'energy dominance doctrine,' expert says
item.summary: Reports indicate President Donald Trump's administration is considering a direct attack on Iran's Kharg Island, which handles 90% of Iranian oil exports near the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: ISIS-inspired NYC bomb suspects could face death penalty, ex-FBI agent says
item.summary: Two ISIS-inspired suspects in an alleged NYC bomb plot could face the death penalty, retired FBI agent James Gagliano said as federal prosecutors assume control.

item.title: FBI offers $1M reward for capture of 'Ten Most Wanted' 300-pound suspect possibly hiding in Mexico
item.summary: The FBI raised the reward to $1 million for Omar Cardenas, accused of fatally shooting a man in California. The dangerous fugitive may be hiding somewhere in Mexico, according to officials.

item.title: Mike Johnson warns Sharia law 'serious problem' after GOP rep's anti-Muslim post
item.summary: Speaker Mike Johnson says the threat of Sharia law in America is a “serious problem," warning its tenets run afoul of the U.S. Constitution.

item.title: Fox News Poll: Voters expect AI to transform our lives — but today is not that day
item.summary: Fox News poll reveals 53% of voters believe artificial intelligence will dramatically change American life, up from 43% in 2023 amid trust concerns.

item.title: Life-sentenced rapist who called break-in attack his 'Super Bowl' wins early release after just a decade
item.summary: California parole board approves release of convicted sex offender despite prosecutor concerns about incomplete treatment programs for sexual violence.

item.title: WATCH: Dem witness accuses Trump of ‘population purge,’ Kennedy fires back: ‘You trigger my gag reflex’
item.summary: A Democrat-called witness at a Senate hearing drew a draw-dropping response from Sen. John Kennedy, R-La., after accusing the Trump administration of attempting a "population purge."

item.title: Trump urges Congress to pass SAVE America Act, fully fund DHS as TSA workers go without pay
item.summary: Over 100,000 federal workers go without pay as Trump urges Congress to fund DHS and pass the SAVE America Act, which would require proof of citizenship to vote.
